leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Execute the Angular CLI command to generate a new project with default settings
Apply TypeScript configuration to establish strict type checking for the project
Construct the core application component with proper Angular decorator syntax
Utilize component templates to define the initial HTML structure
Implement component styles to apply basic CSS formatting
Define the application module to declare and bootstrap components
Invoke the development server to compile and serve the application locally
Access the application in a web browser to verify the scaffolded project
Modify the default component template to display custom content
Control project structure by navigating and inspecting generated files and folders
Apply Angular CLI commands to generate additional components within the project
Use the package.json file to manage project dependencies and scripts
